headline: Minecraft: 400 million copies
title: Minecraft Sold 400 Million Copies | Microsoft Bought It for Billions | Minecraft Facts
video_script: Minecraft is now the best selling video game of all time, with more than four hundred million copies sold. In two thousand fourteen, Microsoft bought Mojang and Minecraft for two point five billion dollars. Notch created it, and after the full release Jens Bergensten, known as Jeb, took over development. Java or Bedrock? Comment below!
